title: Compliance Deadlines You Can't Miss
subtitle: 27 Sep – 30 Oct 2026 · for companies, OPCs and LLPs in India
author: Vaidam Consultancy LLP

stories.headline: AOC-4 for One Person Companies
stories.summary: OPCs must file their FY 2025-26 financial statements with the ROC. The late fee is ₹100 per day with no upper limit.
stories.why: File today or tomorrow. Every day of delay adds ₹100.

stories.headline: Tax Audit Report
stories.summary: For businesses that need a tax audit for FY 2025-26. No CBDT extension notified yet. A bank strike is planned for 28–30 Sep.
stories.why: Pay dues and file early. Penalty: 0.5% of turnover, up to ₹1.5 lakh.

stories.headline: ADT-1: tell the ROC about your auditor
stories.summary: Companies must file ADT-1 within 15 days of appointing an auditor. For an AGM on 30 Sep, that means 15 Oct.
stories.why: Pass the resolution at your AGM and file ADT-1 right after.

stories.headline: AOC-4 for companies, Form 8 for LLPs
stories.summary: Companies file annual financial statements (AOC-4) by 29 Oct. LLPs file Statement of Accounts & Solvency (Form 8) by 30 Oct.
stories.why: Get accounts finalised now. Both cost ₹100 per day if late.

stories.headline: DIR-3 KYC is now once every 3 years
stories.summary: From 31 Mar 2026, directors file DIR-3 KYC once every three financial years instead of every year.
stories.why: KYC done for FY 2025-26? Your next due date is 30 June 2028.
